summary: Round-4 frontend E2E tested on preview for the 4 new marketing features. 5 of 6 specified checks PASS. One real BUG found: on /checkout, the flash-sale product (蜜果直播 spec 15640-218076) is listed at ORIGINAL price $8.69 instead of the flash price $4.34, and the subtotal + promo-hint banner both reflect $8.69. Everything else (home flash section + countdown, home lottery entry, /lottery unauth-draw-opens-auth-modal, authed draw deducting 100 points with result/history/close, gift-card product auto-dispatching GC code on wallet payment and surfacing it in order detail with copy button) works as specified.

ui_bugs.issue: Flash-sale item 蜜果直播 (product 15640, spec 15640-218076) renders in /checkout at the ORIGINAL $8.69 instead of the active flash price $4.34. cart-subtotal = $8.69, cart-item line price = 'USD$ 8.69'. The promo-hint banner is correct for the (wrong) subtotal: 'checkout-cartpromo-hint: 再买 $41.31 即可立减 $5.00（全场满减）' — but with the correct flash price the hint should read '再买 $45.66'. Root cause is almost certainly client-side: the cart line uses the spec's base price (p.price) and Checkout computes subtotal client-side (sum of qty * i.price) rather than driving from GET /orders/quote or from the /flash-sales/public override. The backend _compute_order DOES apply the flash price on order submit (per E1's curl verification), so the user is still charged the correct $4.34 — but the Checkout display is misleading. User-facing bug.

action_items: Fix Checkout.jsx / CartContext: when a cart line's product_id + spec_id matches an active entry from GET /api/flash-sales/public, override the displayed price to flash_price_usd for the cart item line, the cart-subtotal, and the promoHint calculation. Easiest fix: fetch /flash-sales/public once in Checkout, build a Map keyed by `${product_id}:${spec_id}` → flash_price_usd, and use effectivePrice(i) = flashMap.get(key) ?? i.price everywhere subtotal/qty math happens (same substitution the Home flash card already does). Alternative: have the cart/checkout read totals from POST /orders/quote (which _compute_order already applies flash pricing in) and display quote.subtotal_usd + quote.items[].unit_price.
Add a visible 'FLASH 秒杀价' badge + strike-through original price on the cart item in Checkout to match the Home card treatment, so the user sees the promo they are getting.
After fix, re-verify promo-hint math: with flash price 4.34 the hint should say '再买 $45.66 即可立减 $5.00（全场满减）' (50-4.34).
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx subtotal is computed client-side from CartContext item prices and does not consult /flash-sales/public, so any price promotion (flash, future per-user coupons on specific SKUs, bundle pricing) will silently display the wrong number in the cart while the backend actually charges the discounted amount. Prefer a single source of truth: drive subtotal/line pricing from /orders/quote.

The cart line still shows just 'USD$ <base>' with no flash badge / strike-through. From a UX perspective, even once the subtotal math is fixed, users need visual confirmation that they're getting the flash deal in the cart, not just on the home card.

Lottery.jsx: the result modal shows the raw prize `name` from the backend ('谢谢惠顾'); that works, but the lottery-history row contains BOTH '谢谢惠顾' AND the real monetary line 'USD$0.5 余额' from an earlier draw — meaning past draws without a monetary payout still render fine, but there is no visible 'cost: -100 积分' line in history. Consider adding `-100 积分` under each history row for symmetry with 'lottery-points' bookkeeping.

Home flash card: flash-countdown is 'HH:MM:SS' built with `Box`-wrapped digits; when the sale is <1h away the hh box still reads '05' etc. — works, but there is no end-of-sale state (what happens visually at 00:00:00?). Verify the FlashSaleSection hides or re-fetches when countdown hits 0 (not reproduced in this run because countdown was ~5h49m).

rca of the issue: Flash-sale discount is applied server-side in _compute_order (confirmed by E1 via curl and by the fact that the GC order succeeded end-to-end), but the storefront Checkout page builds its own subtotal from CartContext line prices which are the spec's base price (p.price from /products or /cart). The cart lines never consult /api/flash-sales/public (unlike the Home FlashSaleSection which does), so the UI shows $8.69 for the flash spec. Mitigation: in Checkout.jsx (or inside CartContext), fetch /flash-sales/public and apply flash_price_usd when (item.product_id === f.product_id && item.spec_id === f.spec_id). Even simpler and more future-proof: switch the Checkout summary (subtotal, discount, total, promo-hint) to be rendered from quote data returned by POST /api/orders/quote, which already does the correct flash+level+promo+points arithmetic.
